queries.question: Is the expected domain present in the graph?
queries.query: MATCH (d:Domain) WHERE d.name = {domain} RETURN d LIMIT 1
queries.interpretation: A domain node exists; this alone does not prove it came from this run.
queries.limitations: The BloodHound graph can contain older or merged data. Results are instance-wide and may include older or merged data; LIMIT bounds returned rows, not total query work.

queries.question: Resolve one principal by its exact SID.
queries.query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.objectid = {sid} RETURN n LIMIT 1
queries.interpretation: The returned node identifies the requested principal.
queries.limitations: Presence does not establish credentials, privileges, or current activity. Results are instance-wide and may include older or merged data; LIMIT bounds returned rows, not total query work.

queries.question: Which groups are reachable through membership from this principal?
queries.query: MATCH p=(n)-[:MemberOf*1..5]->(g:Group) WHERE n.objectid = {sid} RETURN p LIMIT 25
queries.interpretation: Membership subgraph within five hops; returned edges retain their direction.
queries.limitations: Bounded output may omit other membership chains. Graph presence is not an effective-token check. Results are instance-wide and may include older or merged data; LIMIT bounds returned rows, not total query work.

queries.question: Is there a bounded candidate path between two specified principals?
queries.query: MATCH (s), (t) WHERE s.objectid = {source_sid} AND t.objectid = {target_sid} MATCH p=shortestPath((s)-[:MemberOf|GenericAll|GenericWrite|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|Owns|ForceChangePassword|AddMember*1..6]->(t)) RETURN p LIMIT 1
queries.interpretation: Candidate relationship chain, not an executed or confirmed attack path.
queries.limitations: At most six hops and the listed edge types only. Does not cover sessions, local administration, all delegation or trust behavior. Missing paths do not establish safety. Results are instance-wide and may include older or merged data; LIMIT bounds returned rows, not total query work.

queries.question: Which Domain Admins group belongs to the selected domain?
queries.query: MATCH (g:Group) WHERE g.domain = {domain} AND g.objectid ENDS WITH '-512' RETURN g LIMIT 50
queries.interpretation: Identifies the domain-specific RID-512 group without relying on its localized name.
queries.limitations: This is group identification, not an effective-privilege or current-membership check. Results are instance-wide and may include older or merged data; LIMIT bounds returned rows, not total query work.

queries.question: Which enabled users have a membership chain to Domain Admins in this domain?
queries.query: MATCH p=(u:User)-[:MemberOf*1..5]->(g:Group) WHERE g.domain = {domain} AND g.objectid ENDS WITH '-512' AND u.enabled = true RETURN p LIMIT 50
queries.interpretation: Shows enabled-user membership chains up to five hops into the domain RID-512 group.
queries.limitations: Computers, disabled users, deeper chains, missing enabled properties, and effective-token details are outside this query. Results are instance-wide and may include older or merged data; LIMIT bounds returned rows, not total query work.

queries.question: Which enabled ordinary user accounts have SPNs in the selected domain?
queries.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.domain = {domain} AND u.hasspn = true AND u.enabled = true AND NOT u.objectid ENDS WITH '-502' AND NOT COALESCE(u.gmsa, false) = true AND NOT COALESCE(u.msa, false) = true RETURN u LIMIT 50
queries.interpretation: Identifies SPN-bearing enabled users for further assessment; no ticket request or password recovery occurs.
queries.limitations: Missing gmsa/msa metadata is treated as false, so managed accounts may remain. SPN presence does not establish weak credentials, obtainable tickets, or successful cracking. Results are instance-wide and may include older or merged data; LIMIT bounds returned rows, not total query work.

queries.question: Which enabled users have Kerberos preauthentication disabled in this domain?
queries.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.domain = {domain} AND u.dontreqpreauth = true AND u.enabled = true RETURN u LIMIT 50
queries.interpretation: Identifies the collected account configuration; no AS-REP request or credential recovery occurs.
queries.limitations: Missing properties and uncollected identities are omitted. Current KDC behavior, password strength, and usable authentication remain unverified. Results are instance-wide and may include older or merged data; LIMIT bounds returned rows, not total query work.

queries.question: Which enabled computers have unconstrained delegation configured in this domain?
queries.query: MATCH (c:Computer) WHERE c.domain = {domain} AND c.unconstraineddelegation = true AND c.enabled = true RETURN c LIMIT 50
queries.interpretation: Finds the collected unconstrained-delegation setting on enabled computers, including domain controllers.
queries.limitations: Domain controllers are deliberately included: this collector does not directly emit isdc. Configuration alone proves neither a usable ticket nor an active privileged session. Results are instance-wide and may include older or merged data; LIMIT bounds returned rows, not total query work.

queries.question: Which computers are configured delegation destinations for this principal?
queries.query: MATCH p=(n)-[:AllowedToDelegate]->(c:Computer) WHERE n.objectid = {sid} RETURN p LIMIT 50
queries.interpretation: Shows configured outbound constrained-delegation relationships from the exact SID.
queries.limitations: Only direct relationships and resolved destinations appear. Credentials, allowed services, protocol-transition prerequisites, protected users, and effective use require separate validation. Results are instance-wide and may include older or merged data; LIMIT bounds returned rows, not total query work.

queries.question: Which principals have resource-based constrained delegation to this computer SID?
queries.query: MATCH p=(n)-[:AllowedToAct]->(c:Computer) WHERE c.objectid = {sid} RETURN p LIMIT 50
queries.interpretation: Shows incoming configured RBCD relationships to the selected computer; no Tier Zero classification is assumed.
queries.limitations: The msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity attribute must be readable and schema-resolved. Principal credentials, service reachability, and effective impersonation are not established. Results are instance-wide and may include older or merged data; LIMIT bounds returned rows, not total query work.

queries.question: Which objects have a direct selected control relationship from this exact principal?
queries.query: MATCH p=(s)-[:GenericAll|GenericWrite|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|Owns|ForceChangePassword|AddMember]->(t) WHERE s.objectid = {sid} RETURN p LIMIT 50
queries.interpretation: Shows selected direct object-control edges, retaining target type and relationship direction.
queries.limitations: Group-derived rights are not expanded. These edges have different prerequisites and consequences; control does not prove a mutation or compromise. Modern or unlisted ACL edge types are omitted. Results are instance-wide and may include older or merged data; LIMIT bounds returned rows, not total query work.

queries.question: Which principals have a direct selected control relationship to this exact object SID?
queries.query: MATCH p=(s)-[:GenericAll|GenericWrite|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|Owns|ForceChangePassword|AddMember]->(t) WHERE t.objectid = {sid} RETURN p LIMIT 50
queries.interpretation: Finds selected direct controllers of a SID-addressable object for follow-up membership and prerequisite analysis.
queries.limitations: The SID parameter cannot address GUID-only objects such as GPOs. Group-derived rights and unlisted ACL types are not expanded; relationships are opportunities, not executed actions. Results are instance-wide and may include older or merged data; LIMIT bounds returned rows, not total query work.

queries.question: Which GPOs have a direct control relationship from this principal SID?
queries.query: MATCH p=(s)-[:GenericAll|GenericWrite|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|Owns]->(g:GPO) WHERE s.objectid = {sid} RETURN p LIMIT 50
queries.interpretation: Finds direct control of GPO directory objects from the selected principal without requiring a GPO SID.
queries.limitations: Group-derived permissions are not expanded. Directory-object control alone does not establish SYSVOL write access, effective GPO application, filtering, inheritance, or code execution. Results are instance-wide and may include older or merged data; LIMIT bounds returned rows, not total query work.

queries.question: Which principals have direct graph relationships indicating replication control over this domain?
queries.query: MATCH p=(n)-[:DCSync|AllExtendedRights|GenericAll]->(d:Domain) WHERE d.name = {domain} RETURN p LIMIT 50
queries.interpretation: Shows direct DCSync or broader domain-control candidates; group nodes require membership follow-up.
queries.limitations: DCSync is derived from the combination of GetChanges and GetChangesAll, not either alone. Graph analysis must have completed; group-derived combinations, authentication and live replication success are not proved. No replication request is sent. Results are instance-wide and may include older or merged data; LIMIT bounds returned rows, not total query work.

queries.question: Which direct members of groups in this domain have a different collected domain SID?
queries.query: MATCH p=(s)-[:MemberOf]->(g:Group) WHERE g.domain = {domain} AND s.domainsid <> g.domainsid RETURN p LIMIT 50
queries.interpretation: Highlights direct cross-domain memberships into groups in the selected domain.
queries.limitations: Missing source/domain SID metadata is omitted, and DCOnly may leave foreign principals unresolved. Membership does not prove a traversable trust, effective access, or complete foreign-domain coverage. Results are instance-wide and may include older or merged data; LIMIT bounds returned rows, not total query work.

deferred_queries.question: Which principals have host-local token privilege relationships?
blockers: PR 1999 was closed without merging on 2026-10-10; its proposed privilege edges are absent from the reviewed CE v9.9.0 AD schema.
Current Python BloodHound DCOnly does not collect host-local token privileges.

deferred_queries.question: Which principals have live sessions or host-local administration relationships?
blockers: Current DCOnly coverage excludes Session and LocalAdmin collection.
Older instance-wide edges cannot be attributed to the current run; a separate collector/coverage implementation is required.

deferred_queries.question: Which certificate enrollment configurations form ADCS candidate paths?
blockers: This adapter has no validated ADCS collection coverage or corresponding artifact validation.
Do not treat imported legacy or unrelated ADCS edges as evidence from this DCOnly run.
